### DiagonalMatrixMultiply\`\`1(side,A,x,strideX,C) `method`

##### Summary

This function performs the matrix-matrix multiplication `C` = `A` diag(`x`) if `side` == [Right](#F-CudaCSharp-SideMode-Right 'CudaCSharp.SideMode.Right') or `C` = diag(`x`) * `A` otherwise.

##### Parameters

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| side | [CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix{\`\`0}](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix{``0} 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix{``0}') | left or right multiply |
| A | [CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseVector{\`\`0}](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseVector{``0} 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseVector{``0}') | input [DenseMatrix\`1](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix`1 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix`1') |
| x | [CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix{\`\`0}](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix{``0} 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix{``0}') | input [DenseVector\`1](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseVector`1 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseVector`1') |
| strideX | [CudaCSharp.SideMode](#T-CudaCSharp-SideMode 'CudaCSharp.SideMode') | stride of vector `x` |
| C | [System.Int32](http://msdn.microsoft.com/query/dev14.query?appId=Dev14IDEF1&l=EN-US&k=k:System.Int32 'System.Int32') | output [DenseMatrix\`1](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix`1 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix`1') |

<a name='M-CudaCSharp-Blas-API-MatrixGeneralAdd``1-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix{``0},CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix{``0},CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix{``0},``0,``0,CudaCSharp-MatrixOperation,CudaCSharp-MatrixOperation-'></a>
### MatrixGeneralAdd\`\`1(α,A,opA,β,B,opB,C) `method`

##### Summary

Calculate $C = \alpha A^{\text{opA}} + \beta B^{\text{opB}}$, implemented in CUDA BLAS by adding over every corresponding elements. `A`, `B` or `C` may be the same.

##### Parameters

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| α | [CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix{\`\`0}](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix{``0} 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix{``0}') | scalar of type `T` with default 0. If ` == 0`, `A` can be an invalid input |
| A | [CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix{\`\`0}](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix{``0} 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix{``0}') | the [DenseMatrix\`1](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix`1 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix`1') A |
| opA | [CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix{\`\`0}](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix{``0} 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix{``0}') | operation to matrix `A` |
| β | [\`\`0](#T-``0 '``0') | scalar of type `T` with default 0. If ` == 0`, `B` can be an invalid input |
| B | [\`\`0](#T-``0 '``0') | the input [DenseMatrix\`1](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix`1 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix`1') B |
| opB | [CudaCSharp.MatrixOperation](#T-CudaCSharp-MatrixOperation 'CudaCSharp.MatrixOperation') | operation to matrix `B` |
| C | [CudaCSharp.MatrixOperation](#T-CudaCSharp-MatrixOperation 'CudaCSharp.MatrixOperation') | output [DenseMatrix\`1](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix`1 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix`1') C |

##### Exceptions

| Name | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| [System.ArgumentNullException](http://msdn.microsoft.com/query/dev14.query?appId=Dev14IDEF1&l=EN-US&k=k:System.ArgumentNullException 'System.ArgumentNullException') | if any of the array is null |
| [System.ArgumentException](http://msdn.microsoft.com/query/dev14.query?appId=Dev14IDEF1&l=EN-US&k=k:System.ArgumentException 'System.ArgumentException') | if the arrays do not match in size |
| [System.ArgumentOutOfRangeException](http://msdn.microsoft.com/query/dev14.query?appId=Dev14IDEF1&l=EN-US&k=k:System.ArgumentOutOfRangeException 'System.ArgumentOutOfRangeException') | if in-place mode is used while `opA` or `opB` is not [None](#F-CudaCSharp-MatrixOperation-None 'CudaCSharp.MatrixOperation.None') |

##### Remarks

If only some of the matrices are Hermitian and the lower parts of them are not stored, these parts will be used in this method. Hence you need fill it manually ([CopyUpperToLower](#M-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix`1-CopyUpperToLower 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix`1.CopyUpperToLower')) before calling this method.

<a name='M-CudaCSharp-Blas-API-MatrixKronecker``1-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix{``0},CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix{``0},CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix{``0}-'></a>
### MatrixKronecker\`\`1(A,B,dest) `method`

##### Summary

Calculate matrix Kronecker product `dest` = `A` ⊗ `B` using compiled kernels.

##### Parameters

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| A | [CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix{\`\`0}](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix{``0} 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix{``0}') | [DenseMatrix\`1](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix`1 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix`1') at left |
| B | [CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix{\`\`0}](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix{``0} 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix{``0}') | [DenseMatrix\`1](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix`1 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix`1') at right |
| dest | [CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix{\`\`0}](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix{``0} 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix{``0}') | destination [DenseMatrix\`1](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix`1 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix`1'), must be preallocated |

##### Generic Types

| Name | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| T | see [PureArray\`1](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-PureArray`1 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.PureArray`1') for supported data types |

##### Exceptions

| Name | Description |

<a name='M-CudaCSharp-Blas-API-MatrixMultiply``1-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix{``0},CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix{``0},CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix{``0},``0,``0,CudaCSharp-MatrixOperation,CudaCSharp-MatrixOperation-'></a>
### MatrixMultiply\`\`1(A,opA,α,B,opB,β,C) `method`

##### Summary

Directly calculate $C = \alpha A^{\text{opA}} B^{\text{opB}} + \beta C$.

##### Parameters

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| A | [CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix{\`\`0}](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix{``0} 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix{``0}') | the input [DenseMatrix\`1](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix`1 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix`1') A |
| opA | [CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix{\`\`0}](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix{``0} 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix{``0}') | operation to matrix `A` |
| α | [CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix{\`\`0}](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix{``0} 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix{``0}') | scalar of type `T` |
| B | [\`\`0](#T-``0 '``0') | the input [DenseMatrix\`1](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix`1 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix`1') B |
| opB | [\`\`0](#T-``0 '``0') | operation to matrix `B` |
| β | [CudaCSharp.MatrixOperation](#T-CudaCSharp-MatrixOperation 'CudaCSharp.MatrixOperation') | scalar of type `T` with default 0. If `β == 0`, `C` will be completely overridden |
| C | [CudaCSharp.MatrixOperation](#T-CudaCSharp-MatrixOperation 'CudaCSharp.MatrixOperation') | the output [DenseMatrix\`1](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix`1 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix`1') C |

##### Exceptions

| Name | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| [System.ArgumentNullException](http://msdn.microsoft.com/query/dev14.query?appId=Dev14IDEF1&l=EN-US&k=k:System.ArgumentNullException 'System.ArgumentNullException') | if any of the array is null |
| [System.ArgumentException](http://msdn.microsoft.com/query/dev14.query?appId=Dev14IDEF1&l=EN-US&k=k:System.ArgumentException 'System.ArgumentException') | if the arrays do not match in size |

##### Remarks

If `A` is Hermitian and `B` is not while `opB` != [None](#F-CudaCSharp-MatrixOperation-None 'CudaCSharp.MatrixOperation.None'), a temporary [DenseMatrix\`1](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix`1 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix`1') -- the result of `opB`(`B`) will be created to use BLAS function `symm` or `hemm`.



All of the Hermitian matrices except for `A` (or `B` if `B` and `C` are Hermitian) must be filled manually ([CopyUpperToLower](#M-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix`1-CopyUpperToLower 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix`1.CopyUpperToLower')) before calling this method if their lower parts are not actually stored.

### RankKUpdate\`\`1(A,opA,α,β,conjugateA,C) `method`

##### Summary

Perform symmetric (Hermitian) rank-k update $C = \alpha A^{op}A^{\text{op}}^H + \beta C$, where $\alpha$ and $\beta$ are scalars, $C$ is a symmetric (Hermitian) matrix stored in upper mode, and $A$ is a non-Hermitian matrix.

##### Parameters

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| A | [CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix{\`\`0}](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix{``0} 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix{``0}') | non-Hermitian [DenseMatrix\`1](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix`1 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix`1') |
| opA | [CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix{\`\`0}](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix{``0} 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix{``0}') | operation to matrix `A` |
| α | [\`\`0](#T-``0 '``0') | scalar of type `T` |
| β | [\`\`0](#T-``0 '``0') | scalar of type `T` |
| conjugateA | [System.Nullable{System.Boolean}](http://msdn.microsoft.com/query/dev14.query?appId=Dev14IDEF1&l=EN-US&k=k:System.Nullable 'System.Nullable{System.Boolean}') | perform conjugate to `A` or not, default is true for complex and false otherwise |
| C | [CudaCSharp.MatrixOperation](#T-CudaCSharp-MatrixOperation 'CudaCSharp.MatrixOperation') | output [DenseMatrix\`1](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix`1 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix`1'), which will be completely overridden if ` == 0, must be Hermitian` |

##### Exceptions

| Name | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| [System.ArgumentNullException](http://msdn.microsoft.com/query/dev14.query?appId=Dev14IDEF1&l=EN-US&k=k:System.ArgumentNullException 'System.ArgumentNullException') | if any of the array is null |
| [System.ArgumentException](http://msdn.microsoft.com/query/dev14.query?appId=Dev14IDEF1&l=EN-US&k=k:System.ArgumentException 'System.ArgumentException') | if the arrays do not match in size or β ≠ 0 while C is not Hermitian |

<a name='M-CudaCSharp-Solver-API-EigenSolve``2-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseVector{``1},CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix{``0},CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix{``1},CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix{``1},CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix{``0},CudaCSharp-Solver-EigType,CudaCSharp-Solver-EigMode-'></a>
### EigenSolve\`\`2(valOut,leftVecOut,rightVecOut,A,B,mode,eigType) `method`

##### Summary

Calculate the eigenvalues (and eigenvectors) of given matrix `A` for the special eigen-problem -- $A V = V \Lambda$, or matrices pair `A`, `B` for the general one -- $A V = \Lambda B V$ or $A B V = \Lambda V$ or $B A V = \Lambda V$.

##### Parameters

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| valOut | [CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseVector{\`\`1}](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseVector{``1} 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseVector{``1}') | the output eigenvalues, must be preallocated |
| leftVecOut | [CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix{\`\`0}](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix{``0} 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix{``0}') | the output left eigenvectors, if both `A` and `B` are Hermitian, `A` rather than `leftVecOut` is used to store eigenvectors |
| rightVecOut | [CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix{\`\`1}](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix{``1} 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix{``1}') | the output right eigenvectors, if both `A` and `B` are Hermitian, `A` rather than `rightVecOut` is used to store eigenvectors |
| A | [CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix{\`\`1}](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix{``1} 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix{``1}') | the input/output [DenseMatrix\`1](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix`1 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix`1') to calculate eigensystem; destroyed during the calculation if `mode` is [NoVector](#F-CudaCSharp-Solver-EigMode-NoVector 'CudaCSharp.Solver.EigMode.NoVector') or replaced by the eigenvectors if this is a Hermitian problem |
| B | [CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix{\`\`0}](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix{``0} 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix{``0}') | the input [DenseMatrix\`1](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix`1 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix`1') to calculate general eigen-problem; if ` is null`, the normal eigen is performed and `eigType` is not used; otherwise, the general one is performed |
| mode | [CudaCSharp.Solver.EigType](#T-CudaCSharp-Solver-EigType 'CudaCSharp.Solver.EigType') | the [EigMode](#T-CudaCSharp-Solver-EigMode 'CudaCSharp.Solver.EigMode') to indicate whether the eigenvectors should be calculated |
| eigType | [CudaCSharp.Solver.EigMode](#T-CudaCSharp-Solver-EigMode 'CudaCSharp.Solver.EigMode') | the [EigType](#T-CudaCSharp-Solver-EigType 'CudaCSharp.Solver.EigType') to indicate positions of `A` and `B` |

##### Generic Types

| Name | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| T | input data type, see [PureArray\`1](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-PureArray`1 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.PureArray`1') for supported data types |
| TCorr | `valOut` data type, must be corresponding real types of `T` if `A`, `B` are Hermitian or corresponding complex types of `T` otherwise |

##### Exceptions

| Name | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| [System.ArgumentNullException](http://msdn.microsoft.com/query/dev14.query?appId=Dev14IDEF1&l=EN-US&k=k:System.ArgumentNullException 'System.ArgumentNullException') | if `A` or `valOut` is null |
| [System.ArgumentException](http://msdn.microsoft.com/query/dev14.query?appId=Dev14IDEF1&l=EN-US&k=k:System.ArgumentException 'System.ArgumentException') | if the `valOut` is too short or `T` and `TCorr` do not match |
| [System.NotSupportedException](http://msdn.microsoft.com/query/dev14.query?appId=Dev14IDEF1&l=EN-US&k=k:System.NotSupportedException 'System.NotSupportedException') | if `T` or `TCorr` is not one of the supported type |
| [CudaCSharp.StatusException](#T-CudaCSharp-StatusException 'CudaCSharp.StatusException') | if the internal calculation returns error status |
| [CudaCSharp.Solver.MatrixAlgorithmException](#T-CudaCSharp-Solver-MatrixAlgorithmException 'CudaCSharp.Solver.MatrixAlgorithmException') | if the internal calculation fails |

<a name='M-CudaCSharp-Solver-API-LinearSolve``1-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix{``0},CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix{``0}-'></a>
### LinearSolve\`\`1(A,B) `method`

##### Summary

Solve a series of linear systems: $A X = B$, where each column pair of X and `B` is a linear system. 
Both `A` and `B` are in-place where `A` is replaced by its LU decomposition and `B` the solution X.

##### Parameters

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| A | [CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix{\`\`0}](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix{``0} 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix{``0}') | the coefficient [DenseMatrix\`1](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix`1 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix`1') |
| B | [CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix{\`\`0}](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix{``0} 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix{``0}') | each column of this [DenseMatrix\`1](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix`1 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix`1') is the vector at right; overwritten by solution X in the end |

##### Generic Types

| Name | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| T | input data type, see [PureArray\`1](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-PureArray`1 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.PureArray`1') for supported data types |

##### Exceptions

| Name | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| [System.ArgumentNullException](http://msdn.microsoft.com/query/dev14.query?appId=Dev14IDEF1&l=EN-US&k=k:System.ArgumentNullException 'System.ArgumentNullException') | if any of the array is null |
| [System.NotSupportedException](http://msdn.microsoft.com/query/dev14.query?appId=Dev14IDEF1&l=EN-US&k=k:System.NotSupportedException 'System.NotSupportedException') | if `T` is not one of the supported type |
| [CudaCSharp.StatusException](#T-CudaCSharp-StatusException 'CudaCSharp.StatusException') | if the calculation of CUDA Solver onHosts returns error status |
| [CudaCSharp.Solver.MatrixAlgorithmException](#T-CudaCSharp-Solver-MatrixAlgorithmException 'CudaCSharp.Solver.MatrixAlgorithmException') | if the internal calculation fails, mainly caused when `A` has no inverse |

### Schur\`\`1(A,U,order,orderVal) `method`

##### Summary

Schur decompose the given matrix `A`.

##### Returns

the actual number of eigenvalues returned

##### Parameters

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| A | [CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix{\`\`0}](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix{``0} 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix{``0}') | matrix to be decomposed, replaced by the Schur matrix after return |
| U | [System.Int32[]](http://msdn.microsoft.com/query/dev14.query?appId=Dev14IDEF1&l=EN-US&k=k:System.Int32[] 'System.Int32[]') | the output unitary matrix, default null means do not compute |
| order | [CudaCSharp.DoubleComplex[]](#T-CudaCSharp-DoubleComplex[] 'CudaCSharp.DoubleComplex[]') | the orders the factorization so that selected eigenvalues are at the top left of Schur form. Default null means identity permutation, which is sorted descending by the modulus of eigenvalues |
| orderVal | [CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix{\`\`0}](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix{``0} 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix{``0}') | the value order of the factorization so that selected eigenvalues are at the top left of Schur form. Default null means use `order` |

##### Remarks

if both `order` and `orderVal` are indicated, only `orderVal` will be used

<a name='M-CudaCSharp-Solver-API-SingularValues``2-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix{``0},CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseVector{``1},CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix{``0},CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix{``0},CudaCSharp-Solver-SVDStore,CudaCSharp-Solver-SVDStore-'></a>
### SingularValues\`\`2(jobu,jobvt,A,S,U,Vct) `method`

##### Summary

This function computes the singular value decomposition (SVD) of a matrix `A` and corresponding the left and/or right singular vectors: $A = U S V^*$.

##### Parameters

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| jobu | [CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix{\`\`0}](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix{``0} 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix{``0}') | specifies options for computing all or part of the matrix `U` |
| jobvt | [CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseVector{\`\`1}](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseVector{``1} 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseVector{``1}') | specifies options for computing all or part of the matrix `Vct`, same as `jobu` |
| A | [CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix{\`\`0}](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix{``0} 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix{``0}') | input [DenseMatrix\`1](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix`1 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix`1') with size |
| S | [CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix{\`\`0}](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix{``0} 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix{``0}') | output singular values [DenseVector\`1](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseVector`1 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseVector`1') |
| U | [CudaCSharp.Solver.SVDStore](#T-CudaCSharp-Solver-SVDStore 'CudaCSharp.Solver.SVDStore') | output left unitary [DenseMatrix\`1](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix`1 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix`1'), must be pre-allocated if `jobu` is not [Overwrite](#F-CudaCSharp-Solver-SVDStore-Overwrite 'CudaCSharp.Solver.SVDStore.Overwrite') neither [None](#F-CudaCSharp-Solver-SVDStore-None 'CudaCSharp.Solver.SVDStore.None') |
| Vct | [CudaCSharp.Solver.SVDStore](#T-CudaCSharp-Solver-SVDStore 'CudaCSharp.Solver.SVDStore') | output right unitary (`V*`) [DenseMatrix\`1](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix`1 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix`1'), must be pre-allocated if `jobvt` is not [Overwrite](#F-CudaCSharp-Solver-SVDStore-Overwrite 'CudaCSharp.Solver.SVDStore.Overwrite') neither [None](#F-CudaCSharp-Solver-SVDStore-None 'CudaCSharp.Solver.SVDStore.None') |

##### Exceptions

| Name | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| [System.ArgumentNullException](http://msdn.microsoft.com/query/dev14.query?appId=Dev14IDEF1&l=EN-US&k=k:System.ArgumentNullException 'System.ArgumentNullException') | if `A` or `S` is null, or the `U`, `Vct` do not follows the previous rules |
| [System.NotSupportedException](http://msdn.microsoft.com/query/dev14.query?appId=Dev14IDEF1&l=EN-US&k=k:System.NotSupportedException 'System.NotSupportedException') | if `T` or `TReal` is not one of the supported type |
| [CudaCSharp.StatusException](#T-CudaCSharp-StatusException 'CudaCSharp.StatusException') | if the internal calculation returns error status |

### MatrixSparseMultiplyDense\`\`1(α,A,opA,β,B,opB,C) `method`

##### Summary

Compute $C = \alpha A^{\text{opA}} B^{\text{opB}} + \beta C$ for sparse matrix `A` and dense matrices `B` & `C`.

##### Parameters

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| α | [CudaCSharp.Arrays.SparseMatrix{\`\`0}](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-SparseMatrix{``0} 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.SparseMatrix{``0}') | scalar of type `T` with default 0. If ` == 0`, `A` can be an invalid input |
| A | [CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix{\`\`0}](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix{``0} 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix{``0}') | the input [SparseMatrix\`1](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-SparseMatrix`1 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.SparseMatrix`1') A with [CSR](#F-CudaCSharp-SparseMatrixFormat-CSR 'CudaCSharp.SparseMatrixFormat.CSR')/[Coordinated](#F-CudaCSharp-SparseMatrixFormat-Coordinated 'CudaCSharp.SparseMatrixFormat.Coordinated') |
| opA | [CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix{\`\`0}](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix{``0} 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix{``0}') | the [MatrixOperation](#T-CudaCSharp-MatrixOperation 'CudaCSharp.MatrixOperation') to apply on `A` |
| β | [\`\`0](#T-``0 '``0') | scalar of type `T` with default 0. If ` == 0`, `B` can be an invalid input |
| B | [\`\`0](#T-``0 '``0') | the input [DenseMatrix\`1](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix`1 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix`1') B |
| opB | [CudaCSharp.MatrixOperation](#T-CudaCSharp-MatrixOperation 'CudaCSharp.MatrixOperation') | the [MatrixOperation](#T-CudaCSharp-MatrixOperation 'CudaCSharp.MatrixOperation') to apply on `B` |
| C | [CudaCSharp.MatrixOperation](#T-CudaCSharp-MatrixOperation 'CudaCSharp.MatrixOperation') | the input/output [DenseMatrix\`1](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix`1 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix`1') C |

##### Generic Types

| Name | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| T | see [PureArray\`1](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-PureArray`1 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.PureArray`1') for supported data types |

##### Exceptions

| Name | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| [System.ArgumentNullException](http://msdn.microsoft.com/query/dev14.query?appId=Dev14IDEF1&l=EN-US&k=k:System.ArgumentNullException 'System.ArgumentNullException') | if any of the matrices is null |
| [System.ArgumentException](http://msdn.microsoft.com/query/dev14.query?appId=Dev14IDEF1&l=EN-US&k=k:System.ArgumentException 'System.ArgumentException') | if the matrices are not compatible in size or `α` OR `β` is 0 |
| [System.NotSupportedException](http://msdn.microsoft.com/query/dev14.query?appId=Dev14IDEF1&l=EN-US&k=k:System.NotSupportedException 'System.NotSupportedException') | if `T` is not one of the supported type |
| [CudaCSharp.StatusException](#T-CudaCSharp-StatusException 'CudaCSharp.StatusException') | if the calculation of CUDA Sparse methods `csrgeam` return error status |

##### Remarks

If `B` is Hermitian and the lower part of it are not stored, this part will be used in this method. Hence you need fill it manually ([CopyUpperToLower](#M-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix`1-CopyUpperToLower 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix`1.CopyUpperToLower')) before calling this method.

<a name='M-CudaCSharp-SparseBlas-API-VectorToFromCOOMatrix``1-CudaCSharp-Arrays-SparseVector{``0},CudaCSharp-Arrays-SparseMatrix{``0},System-Boolean-'></a>
### VectorToFromCOOMatrix\`\`1(vec,mat,toCOO) `method`

##### Summary

Convert the sparse vector's index array to / from a COOC sparse matrix's index arrays by mod and quotient. The value array will not be copied.

##### Returns

The new row index pointer and column index pointer

##### Parameters

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| vec | [CudaCSharp.Arrays.SparseVector{\`\`0}](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-SparseVector{``0} 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.SparseVector{``0}') | the input [SparseVector\`1](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-SparseVector`1 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.SparseVector`1') |
| mat | [CudaCSharp.Arrays.SparseMatrix{\`\`0}](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-SparseMatrix{``0} 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.SparseMatrix{``0}') | the output [SparseMatrix\`1](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-SparseMatrix`1 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.SparseMatrix`1') |
| toCOO | [System.Boolean](http://msdn.microsoft.com/query/dev14.query?appId=Dev14IDEF1&l=EN-US&k=k:System.Boolean 'System.Boolean') | convert to COOC matrix or backward |

##### Exceptions

| Name | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| [System.ArgumentException](http://msdn.microsoft.com/query/dev14.query?appId=Dev14IDEF1&l=EN-US&k=k:System.ArgumentException 'System.ArgumentException') | if `mat` is not of [COOC](#F-CudaCSharp-SparseMatrixFormat-COOC 'CudaCSharp.SparseMatrixFormat.COOC') |
| [CudaCSharp.StatusException](#T-CudaCSharp-StatusException 'CudaCSharp.StatusException') | if the calculation of custom CUDA method `indexToCOO` returns error status |
| [System.OverflowException](http://msdn.microsoft.com/query/dev14.query?appId=Dev14IDEF1&l=EN-US&k=k:System.OverflowException 'System.OverflowException') | if leading dimension cannot be casted into [Int32](http://msdn.microsoft.com/query/dev14.query?appId=Dev14IDEF1&l=EN-US&k=k:System.Int32 'System.Int32') without loss |

##### Remarks

Since all [SparseVector\`1](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-SparseVector`1 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.SparseVector`1') are maintained sorted, the result arrays will be sorted in the column first order, which can be converted to [CSC](#F-CudaCSharp-SparseMatrixFormat-CSC 'CudaCSharp.SparseMatrixFormat.CSC') format.

### Permute\`\`1(newOrder,α,op,A,B) `method`

##### Summary

Permute (general transpose) and scale this tensor to form a new tensor: $B_{i_0,i_1,...,i_n} = \alpha \Psi(A_{\Pi(i_0,i_1,...,i_n)})$.

##### Parameters

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| newOrder | [CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseTensor{\`\`0}](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseTensor{``0} 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseTensor{``0}') | the new permutation order in [TensorOrder](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-TensorOrder 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.TensorOrder') |
| α | [\`\`0](#T-``0 '``0') | the scalar to multiply |
| op | [CudaCSharp.UnitaryOperation](#T-CudaCSharp-UnitaryOperation 'CudaCSharp.UnitaryOperation') | the [UnitaryOperation](#T-CudaCSharp-UnitaryOperation 'CudaCSharp.UnitaryOperation')`Ψ` to apply on each element before scaling |
| A | [CudaCSharp.Arrays.TensorOrder](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-TensorOrder 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.TensorOrder') | the source tensor |
| B | [CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseTensor{\`\`0}](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseTensor{``0} 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseTensor{``0}') | the output tensor |

##### Generic Types

| Name | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| T | see [PureArray\`1](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-PureArray`1 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.PureArray`1') for supported data types |

<a name='M-CudaCSharp-Tensor-API-Reduce``1-CudaCSharp-BinaryOperation,``0,CudaCSharp-UnitaryOperation,CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseTensor{``0},``0,CudaCSharp-UnitaryOperation,CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseTensor{``0},CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseTensor{``0}-'></a>
### Reduce\`\`1(reduction,α,opA,A,β,opC,C,D) `method`

##### Summary

Partial reduction of tensor `A`: $D_{\Pi^C(i_0,i_1,...,i_n)} = \alpha \Phi(\Psi_A(A_{\Pi^A(i_0,i_1,...,i_n)})) + \beta \Psi_C(C_{\Pi^C(i_0,i_1,...,i_n)})$. The missing indices of `A` compared to `C` will be aggregated according to `reduction`.

##### Parameters

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| reduction | [CudaCSharp.BinaryOperation](#T-CudaCSharp-BinaryOperation 'CudaCSharp.BinaryOperation') | the reduce [BinaryOperation](#T-CudaCSharp-BinaryOperation 'CudaCSharp.BinaryOperation')`Φ` |
| α | [\`\`0](#T-``0 '``0') | scalar α |
| opA | [CudaCSharp.UnitaryOperation](#T-CudaCSharp-UnitaryOperation 'CudaCSharp.UnitaryOperation') | [UnitaryOperation](#T-CudaCSharp-UnitaryOperation 'CudaCSharp.UnitaryOperation')`ΨA` |
| A | [CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseTensor{\`\`0}](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseTensor{``0} 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseTensor{``0}') | [DenseTensor\`1](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseTensor`1 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseTensor`1') A |
| β | [\`\`0](#T-``0 '``0') | scalar β, default 0 |
| opC | [CudaCSharp.UnitaryOperation](#T-CudaCSharp-UnitaryOperation 'CudaCSharp.UnitaryOperation') | [UnitaryOperation](#T-CudaCSharp-UnitaryOperation 'CudaCSharp.UnitaryOperation')`ΨC`, default identity |
| C | [CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseTensor{\`\`0}](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseTensor{``0} 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseTensor{``0}') | [DenseTensor\`1](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseTensor`1 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseTensor`1') C, default null |
| D | [CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseTensor{\`\`0}](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseTensor{``0} 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseTensor{``0}') | output tensor D |

##### Remarks

If `C` is null, or `β` is zero, this tensor itself will be used instead of `C`.

<a name='M-CudaCSharp-General-ArrayOperations-KroneckerProdTimesThis``3-``1,``0,``0,``2-'></a>
### KroneckerProdTimesThis\`\`3(vec,A,B,α) `method`

##### Summary

Calculate $(A \otimes B) \cdot \vec{v}_{\text{this}}$ out-of-place.

##### Returns

$\alpha (A \otimes B) \cdot \vec{v}_{\text{this}} = \alpha (B V A^T)$ where $V=$`this.ToMatrix(.SecondDim)`.

##### Parameters

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| vec | [\`\`1](#T-``1 '``1') | input vector `TVec` |
| A | [\`\`0](#T-``0 '``0') | input matrix `TMat` A |
| B | [\`\`0](#T-``0 '``0') | input matrix `TMat` B |
| α | [\`\`2](#T-``2 '``2') | scalar to multiply the result |

##### Generic Types

| Name | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| T | the data type, see [AbstractArray\`1](#T-CudaCSharp-AbstractArray`1 'CudaCSharp.AbstractArray`1') for more detail |
| TMat | the concrete matrix type that inherits [AbstractArray\`1](#T-CudaCSharp-AbstractArray`1 'CudaCSharp.AbstractArray`1') and [IMatrix\`3](#T-CudaCSharp-IMatrix`3 'CudaCSharp.IMatrix`3') |
| TVec | the concrete vector type that inherits [AbstractArray\`1](#T-CudaCSharp-AbstractArray`1 'CudaCSharp.AbstractArray`1') and [IVector\`3](#T-CudaCSharp-IVector`3 'CudaCSharp.IVector`3') |

<a name='M-CudaCSharp-General-ArrayOperations-KroneckerSumTimesThis``3-``1,``0,``0,``2,System-Boolean-'></a>
### KroneckerSumTimesThis\`\`3(vec,A,B,α,makeResultHermation) `method`

##### Summary

Calculate $(A \oplus B) \cdot \vec{v}_{\text{this}}$ out-of-place.

##### Returns

$\alpha \cdot (A \oplus B) \cdot \vec{v}_{\text{this}} = \alpha (V A^T + B V)$ where $V=$`this.ToMatrix(.LeadDim)`. If both `A` and `B` are Hermitian or `makeResultHermation` is false, only $V A^T + B V$ will be calculated; otherwise, the rank-k update $\alpha [V(A^T+\bar{A})+(B+B^H)V]/2$ will be used.

##### Parameters

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| vec | [\`\`1](#T-``1 '``1') | input vector `TVec` |
| A | [\`\`0](#T-``0 '``0') | input matrix `TMat` A |
| B | [\`\`0](#T-``0 '``0') | input matrix `TMat` B |
| α | [\`\`2](#T-``2 '``2') | scalar to multiply the result |
| makeResultHermation | [System.Boolean](http://msdn.microsoft.com/query/dev14.query?appId=Dev14IDEF1&l=EN-US&k=k:System.Boolean 'System.Boolean') | force the result to be Hermitian or not |

##### Generic Types

| Name | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| T | the data type, see [AbstractArray\`1](#T-CudaCSharp-AbstractArray`1 'CudaCSharp.AbstractArray`1') for more detail |
| TMat | the concrete matrix type that inherits [AbstractArray\`1](#T-CudaCSharp-AbstractArray`1 'CudaCSharp.AbstractArray`1') and [IMatrix\`3](#T-CudaCSharp-IMatrix`3 'CudaCSharp.IMatrix`3') |
| TVec | the concrete vector type that inherits [AbstractArray\`1](#T-CudaCSharp-AbstractArray`1 'CudaCSharp.AbstractArray`1') and [IVector\`3](#T-CudaCSharp-IVector`3 'CudaCSharp.IVector`3') |

<a name='M-CudaCSharp-General-ArrayOperations-Symmetrize``2-``0,``1,System-Boolean-'></a>
### Symmetrize\`\`2(A,α,conjugateAtLast) `method`

##### Summary

Symmetrize matrix by adding its conjugate transpose out-of-place.

##### Returns

If ` == false`: $B_{\text{result}}=\alpha \frac{A + A^H}{2}$; otherwise: $B_{\text{result}}=\alpha \frac{\bar{A} + A^T}{2}$

##### Parameters

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| A | [\`\`0](#T-``0 '``0') | the input `TMat` |
| α | [\`\`1](#T-``1 '``1') | scalar to multiply the result |
| conjugateAtLast | [System.Boolean](http://msdn.microsoft.com/query/dev14.query?appId=Dev14IDEF1&l=EN-US&k=k:System.Boolean 'System.Boolean') | return the original |

##### Generic Types

| Name | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| T | the data type, see [AbstractArray\`1](#T-CudaCSharp-AbstractArray`1 'CudaCSharp.AbstractArray`1') for more detail |
| TMat | the matrix type that inherits [AbstractArray\`1](#T-CudaCSharp-AbstractArray`1 'CudaCSharp.AbstractArray`1') and [IMatrix\`3](#T-CudaCSharp-IMatrix`3 'CudaCSharp.IMatrix`3') |

<a name='T-CudaCSharp-CudaError'></a>
## CudaError `type`

##### Namespace

CudaCSharp

##### Summary

Error codes returned by CUDA driver API calls

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorAddressOfConstant'></a>
### ErrorAddressOfConstant `constants`

##### Summary

This indicated that the user has taken the address of a constant variable,
which was forbidden up until the CUDA 3.1 release.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorAlreadyAcquired'></a>
### ErrorAlreadyAcquired `constants`

##### Summary

This indicates that a resource has already been acquired.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorAlreadyMapped'></a>
### ErrorAlreadyMapped `constants`

##### Summary

This indicates that the resource is already mapped.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorApiFailureBase'></a>
### ErrorApiFailureBase `constants`

##### Summary

Any unhandled CUDA driver error is added to this value and returned via
the runtime. Production releases of CUDA should not return such errors.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorArrayIsMapped'></a>
### ErrorArrayIsMapped `constants`

##### Summary

This indicates that the specified array is currently mapped and thus
cannot be destroyed.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorAssert'></a>
### ErrorAssert `constants`

##### Summary

An assert triggered in device code during kernel execution. The device
cannot be used again. All existing allocations are invalid. To continue
using CUDA, the process must be terminated and relaunched.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorCapturedEvent'></a>
### ErrorCapturedEvent `constants`

##### Summary

The operation is not permitted on an event which was last recorded in a
capturing stream.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorCompatNotSupportedOnDevice'></a>
### ErrorCompatNotSupportedOnDevice `constants`

##### Summary

This error indicates that the system was upgraded to run with forward compatibility
but the visible hardware detected by CUDA does not support this configuration.
Refer to the compatibility documentation for the supported hardware matrix or ensure
that only supported hardware is visible during initialization via the CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
environment variable.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorContextIsDestroyed'></a>
### ErrorContextIsDestroyed `constants`

##### Summary

This error indicates that the context current to the calling thread
has been destroyed using ::cuCtxDestroy, or is a primary context which
has not yet been initialized.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorCooperativeLaunchTooLarge'></a>
### ErrorCooperativeLaunchTooLarge `constants`

##### Summary

This error indicates that the number of blocks launched per grid for a kernel that was
launched via either ::cudaLaunchCooperativeKernel or ::cudaLaunchCooperativeKernelMultiDevice
exceeds the maximum number of blocks as allowed by ::cudaOccupancyMaxActiveBlocksPerMultiprocessor
or ::cudaOccupancyMaxActiveBlocksPerMultiprocessorWithFlags times the number of multiprocessors
as specified by the device attribute ::cudaDevAttrMultiProcessorCount.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorDeinitialized'></a>
### ErrorDeinitialized `constants`

##### Summary

This indicates that a CUDA Runtime API call cannot be executed because it is being called during process shut down, at a point in time after CUDA driver has been unloaded

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorDeviceAlreadyInUse'></a>
### ErrorDeviceAlreadyInUse `constants`

##### Summary

This indicates that a call tried to access an exclusive-thread device that 
is already in use by a different thread.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorDeviceUninitialized'></a>
### ErrorDeviceUninitialized `constants`

##### Summary

This most frequently indicates that there is no context bound to the
current thread. This can also be returned if the context passed to an
API call is not a valid handle (such as a context that has had
::cuCtxDestroy() invoked on it). This can also be returned if a user
mixes different API versions (i.e. 3010 context with 3020 API calls).
See ::cuCtxGetApiVersion() for more details.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorDevicesUnavailable'></a>
### ErrorDevicesUnavailable `constants`

##### Summary

This indicates that all CUDA devices are busy or unavailable at the current
time. Devices are often busy/unavailable due to use of
'cudaComputeModeExclusive', 'cudaComputeModeProhibited' or when long
running CUDA kernels have filled up the GPU and are blocking new work
from starting. They can also be unavailable due to memory constraints
on a device that already has active CUDA work being performed.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorDuplicateSurfaceName'></a>
### ErrorDuplicateSurfaceName `constants`

##### Summary

This indicates that multiple surfaces (across separate CUDA source
files in the application) share the same string name.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorDuplicateTextureName'></a>
### ErrorDuplicateTextureName `constants`

##### Summary

This indicates that multiple textures (across separate CUDA source
files in the application) share the same string name.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorDuplicateVariableName'></a>
### ErrorDuplicateVariableName `constants`

##### Summary

This indicates that multiple global or constant variables (across separate
CUDA source files in the application) share the same string name.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorECCUncorrectable'></a>
### ErrorECCUncorrectable `constants`

##### Summary

This indicates that an uncorrectable ECC error was detected during
execution.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorFileNotFound'></a>
### ErrorFileNotFound `constants`

##### Summary

This indicates that the file specified was not found.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorGraphExecUpdateFailure'></a>
### ErrorGraphExecUpdateFailure `constants`

##### Summary

This error indicates that the graph update was not performed because it included 
changes which violated constraints specific to instantiated graph update.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorHardwareStackError'></a>
### ErrorHardwareStackError `constants`

##### Summary

Device encountered an error in the call stack during kernel execution,
possibly due to stack corruption or exceeding the stack size limit.
This leaves the process in an inconsistent state and any further CUDA work
will return the same error. To continue using CUDA, the process must be terminated
and relaunched.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorHostMemoryAlreadyRegistered'></a>
### ErrorHostMemoryAlreadyRegistered `constants`

##### Summary

This error indicates that the memory range passed to ::cudaHostRegister()
has already been registered.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorHostMemoryNotRegistered'></a>
### ErrorHostMemoryNotRegistered `constants`

##### Summary

This error indicates that the pointer passed to ::cudaHostUnregister()
does not correspond to any currently registered memory region.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorIllegalAddress'></a>
### ErrorIllegalAddress `constants`

##### Summary

The device encountered a load or store instruction on an invalid memory address.
This leaves the process in an inconsistent state and any further CUDA work
will return the same error. To continue using CUDA, the process must be terminated
and relaunched.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorIllegalInstruction'></a>
### ErrorIllegalInstruction `constants`

##### Summary

The device encountered an illegal instruction during kernel execution
This leaves the process in an inconsistent state and any further CUDA work
will return the same error. To continue using CUDA, the process must be terminated
and relaunched.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorIllegalState'></a>
### ErrorIllegalState `constants`

##### Summary

This indicates that a resource required by the API call is not in a
valid state to perform the requested operation.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorIncompatibleDriverContext'></a>
### ErrorIncompatibleDriverContext `constants`

##### Summary

This indicates that the current context is not compatible with this
the CUDA Runtime. This can only occur if you are using CUDA
Runtime/Driver interoperability and have created an existing Driver
context using the driver API. The Driver context may be incompatible
either because the Driver context was created using an older version 
of the API, because the Runtime API call expects a primary driver 
context and the Driver context is not primary, or because the Driver 
context has been destroyed. Please see 'CUDART_DRIVER' "Interactions 
with the CUDA Driver API" for more information.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorInsufficientDriver'></a>
### ErrorInsufficientDriver `constants`

##### Summary

This indicates that the installed NVIDIA CUDA driver is older than the
CUDA runtime library. This is not a supported configuration. Users should
install an updated NVIDIA display driver to allow the application to run.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorInvalidAddressSpace'></a>
### ErrorInvalidAddressSpace `constants`

##### Summary

While executing a kernel, the device encountered an instruction
which can only operate on memory locations in certain address spaces
(global, shared, or local), but was supplied a memory address not
belonging to an allowed address space.
This leaves the process in an inconsistent state and any further CUDA work
will return the same error. To continue using CUDA, the process must be terminated
and relaunched.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorInvalidChannelDescriptor'></a>
### ErrorInvalidChannelDescriptor `constants`

##### Summary

This indicates that the channel descriptor passed to the API call is not valid. This occurs if the format is not one of the formats specified by 'cudaChannelFormatKind', or if one of the dimensions is invalid.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorInvalidConfiguration'></a>
### ErrorInvalidConfiguration `constants`

##### Summary

This indicates that a kernel launch is requesting resources that can never be satisfied by the current device. Requesting more shared memory per block than the device supports will trigger this error, as will requesting too many threads or blocks. See 'cudaDeviceProp' for more device limitations.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorInvalidDevice'></a>
### ErrorInvalidDevice `constants`

##### Summary

This indicates that the device ordinal supplied by the user does not
correspond to a valid CUDA device.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorInvalidDeviceFunction'></a>
### ErrorInvalidDeviceFunction `constants`

##### Summary

The requested device function does not exist or is not compiled for the
proper device architecture.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorInvalidDevicePointer'></a>
### ErrorInvalidDevicePointer `constants`

##### Summary

This indicates that at least one device pointer passed to the API call is not a valid device pointer.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorInvalidFilterSetting'></a>
### ErrorInvalidFilterSetting `constants`

##### Summary

This indicates that a non-float texture was being accessed with linear
filtering. This is not supported by CUDA.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorInvalidGraphicsContext'></a>
### ErrorInvalidGraphicsContext `constants`

##### Summary

This indicates an error with the OpenGL or DirectX context.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorInvalidHostPointer'></a>
### ErrorInvalidHostPointer `constants`

##### Summary

This indicates that at least one host pointer passed to the API call is not a valid host pointer.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorInvalidKernelImage'></a>
### ErrorInvalidKernelImage `constants`

##### Summary

This indicates that the device kernel image is invalid.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorInvalidMemcpyDirection'></a>
### ErrorInvalidMemcpyDirection `constants`

##### Summary

This indicates that the direction of the [cudaMemcpy](#M-CudaCSharp-Runtime-Cuda-NativeMethods-cudaMemcpy-System-IntPtr,System-IntPtr,System-Int64,CudaCSharp-MemoryCopyKind- 'CudaCSharp.Runtime.Cuda.NativeMethods.cudaMemcpy(System.IntPtr,System.IntPtr,System.Int64,CudaCSharp.MemoryCopyKind)') passed to the API call is not one of the types specified by [MemoryCopyKind](#T-CudaCSharp-MemoryCopyKind 'CudaCSharp.MemoryCopyKind').

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorInvalidNormSetting'></a>
### ErrorInvalidNormSetting `constants`

##### Summary

This indicates that an attempt was made to read a non-float texture as a
normalized float. This is not supported by CUDA.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorInvalidPc'></a>
### ErrorInvalidPc `constants`

##### Summary

The device encountered an invalid program counter.
This leaves the process in an inconsistent state and any further CUDA work
will return the same error. To continue using CUDA, the process must be terminated
and relaunched.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorInvalidPitchValue'></a>
### ErrorInvalidPitchValue `constants`

##### Summary

This indicates that one or more of the pitch-related parameters passed to the API call is not within the acceptable range for pitch.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorInvalidPtx'></a>
### ErrorInvalidPtx `constants`

##### Summary

A PTX compilation failed. The runtime may fall back to compiling PTX if
an application does not contain a suitable binary for the current device.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorInvalidResourceHandle'></a>
### ErrorInvalidResourceHandle `constants`

##### Summary

This indicates that a resource handle passed to the API call was not
valid. Resource handles are opaque types like ::cudaStream_t and
::Event_t.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorInvalidSource'></a>
### ErrorInvalidSource `constants`

##### Summary

This indicates that the device kernel source is invalid.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorInvalidSurface'></a>
### ErrorInvalidSurface `constants`

##### Summary

This indicates that the surface passed to the API call is not a valid
surface.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorInvalidSymbol'></a>
### ErrorInvalidSymbol `constants`

##### Summary

This indicates that the symbol name/identifier passed to the API call is not a valid name or identifier.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorInvalidTexture'></a>
### ErrorInvalidTexture `constants`

##### Summary

This indicates that the texture passed to the API call is not a valid texture.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorInvalidTextureBinding'></a>
### ErrorInvalidTextureBinding `constants`

##### Summary

This indicates that the texture binding is not valid. This occurs if you call 'cudaGetTextureAlignmentOffset()' with an unbound texture.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorInvalidValue'></a>
### ErrorInvalidValue `constants`

##### Summary

This indicates that one or more of the parameters passed to the API call is not within an acceptable range of values

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorJitCompilerNotFound'></a>
### ErrorJitCompilerNotFound `constants`

##### Summary

This indicates that the PTX JIT compiler library was not found. The JIT Compiler
library is used for PTX compilation. The runtime may fall back to compiling PTX
if an application does not contain a suitable binary for the current device.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorLaunchFailure'></a>
### ErrorLaunchFailure `constants`

##### Summary

An exception occurred on the device while executing a kernel. Common
causes include dereferencing an invalid device pointer and accessing
out of bounds shared memory. Less common cases can be system specific - more
information about these cases can be found in the system specific user guide.
This leaves the process in an inconsistent state and any further CUDA work
will return the same error. To continue using CUDA, the process must be terminated
and relaunched.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorLaunchFileScopedSurf'></a>
### ErrorLaunchFileScopedSurf `constants`

##### Summary

This error indicates that a grid launch did not occur because the kernel 
uses file-scoped surfaces which are unsupported by the device runtime.
Kernels launched via the device runtime only support surfaces created with
the Surface Object API's.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorLaunchFileScopedTex'></a>
### ErrorLaunchFileScopedTex `constants`

##### Summary

This error indicates that a grid launch did not occur because the kernel 
uses file-scoped textures which are unsupported by the device runtime. 
Kernels launched via the device runtime only support textures created with 
the Texture Object API's.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorLaunchIncompatibleTexturing'></a>
### ErrorLaunchIncompatibleTexturing `constants`

##### Summary

This error indicates a kernel launch that uses an incompatible texturing
mode.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorLaunchMaxDepthExceeded'></a>
### ErrorLaunchMaxDepthExceeded `constants`

##### Summary

This error indicates that a device runtime grid launch did not occur 
because the depth of the child grid would exceed the maximum supported
number of nested grid launches.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorLaunchOutOfResources'></a>
### ErrorLaunchOutOfResources `constants`

##### Summary

This indicates that a launch did not occur because it did not have
appropriate resources. Although this error is similar to
[ErrorInvalidConfiguration](#F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorInvalidConfiguration 'CudaCSharp.CudaError.ErrorInvalidConfiguration'), this error usually indicates that the
user has attempted to pass too many arguments to the device kernel, or the
kernel launch specifies too many threads for the kernel's register count.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorLaunchPendingCountExceeded'></a>
### ErrorLaunchPendingCountExceeded `constants`

##### Summary

This error indicates that a device runtime grid launch failed because
the launch would exceed the limit ::cudaLimitDevRuntimePendingLaunchCount.
For this launch to proceed successfully, 'cudaDeviceSetLimit' must be
called to set the 'cudaLimitDevRuntimePendingLaunchCount' to be higher 
than the upper bound of outstanding launches that can be issued to the
device runtime. Keep in mind that raising the limit of pending device
runtime launches will require the runtime to reserve device memory that
cannot be used for user allocations.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorLaunchTimeout'></a>
### ErrorLaunchTimeout `constants`

##### Summary

This indicates that the device kernel took too long to execute. This can
only occur if timeouts are enabled - see the device property
\ref ::cudaDeviceProp::kernelExecTimeoutEnabled "kernelExecTimeoutEnabled"
for more information.
This leaves the process in an inconsistent state and any further CUDA work
will return the same error. To continue using CUDA, the process must be terminated
and relaunched.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorMapBufferObjectFailed'></a>
### ErrorMapBufferObjectFailed `constants`

##### Summary

This indicates that the buffer object could not be mapped.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorMemoryValueTooLarge'></a>
### ErrorMemoryValueTooLarge `constants`

##### Summary

This indicated that an emulated device pointer exceeded the 32-bit address range.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorMisalignedAddress'></a>
### ErrorMisalignedAddress `constants`

##### Summary

The device encountered a load or store instruction
on a memory address which is not aligned.
This leaves the process in an inconsistent state and any further CUDA work
will return the same error. To continue using CUDA, the process must be terminated
and relaunched.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorMissingConfiguration'></a>
### ErrorMissingConfiguration `constants`

##### Summary

The device function being invoked (usually via 'cudaLaunchKernel()') was not
previously configured via the 'cudaConfigureCall()' function.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorMixedDeviceExecution'></a>
### ErrorMixedDeviceExecution `constants`

##### Summary

Mixing of device and device emulation code was not allowed.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorNoDevice'></a>
### ErrorNoDevice `constants`

##### Summary

This indicates that no CUDA-capable devices were detected by the installed
CUDA driver.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorNoKernelImageForDevice'></a>
### ErrorNoKernelImageForDevice `constants`

##### Summary

This indicates that there is no kernel image available that is suitable
for the device. This can occur when a user specifies code generation
options for a particular CUDA source file that do not include the
corresponding device configuration.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorNotInitialized'></a>
### ErrorNotInitialized `constants`

##### Summary

The API call failed because the CUDA driver and runtime could not be initialized

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorNotMapped'></a>
### ErrorNotMapped `constants`

##### Summary

This indicates that a resource is not mapped.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorNotMappedAsArray'></a>
### ErrorNotMappedAsArray `constants`

##### Summary

This indicates that a mapped resource is not available for access as an
array.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorNotMappedAsPointer'></a>
### ErrorNotMappedAsPointer `constants`

##### Summary

This indicates that a mapped resource is not available for access as a
pointer.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorNotPermitted'></a>
### ErrorNotPermitted `constants`

##### Summary

This error indicates the attempted operation is not permitted.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorNotReady'></a>
### ErrorNotReady `constants`

##### Summary

This indicates that asynchronous operations issued previously have not
completed yet. This result is not actually an error, but must be indicated
differently than [Success](#F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-Success 'CudaCSharp.CudaError.Success') (which indicates completion). Calls that
may return this value include ::EventQuery() and ::cudaStreamQuery().

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorNotSupported'></a>
### ErrorNotSupported `constants`

##### Summary

This error indicates the attempted operation is not supported
on the current system or device.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorNotYetImplemented'></a>
### ErrorNotYetImplemented `constants`

##### Summary

This indicates that the API call is not yet implemented. Production
releases of CUDA will never return this error.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorNvlinkUncorrectable'></a>
### ErrorNvlinkUncorrectable `constants`

##### Summary

This indicates that an uncorrectable NVLink error was detected during the
execution.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorOperatingSystem'></a>
### ErrorOperatingSystem `constants`

##### Summary

This error indicates that an OS call failed.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorOutOfMemory'></a>
### ErrorOutOfMemory `constants`

##### Summary

The API call failed because it was unable to allocate enough memory to perform the requested operation

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorPeerAccessAlreadyEnabled'></a>
### ErrorPeerAccessAlreadyEnabled `constants`

##### Summary

This error indicates that a call to ::cudaDeviceEnablePeerAccess() is
trying to re-enable peer addressing on from a context which has already
had peer addressing enabled.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorPeerAccessNotEnabled'></a>
### ErrorPeerAccessNotEnabled `constants`

##### Summary

This error indicates that ::cudaDeviceDisablePeerAccess() is trying to 
disable peer addressing which has not been enabled yet via 
::cudaDeviceEnablePeerAccess().

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorPeerAccessUnsupported'></a>
### ErrorPeerAccessUnsupported `constants`

##### Summary

This error indicates that P2P access is not supported across the given
devices.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorPriorLaunchFailure'></a>
### ErrorPriorLaunchFailure `constants`

##### Summary

This indicated that a previous kernel launch failed. This was previously
used for device emulation of kernel launches.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorProfilerAlreadyStarted'></a>
### ErrorProfilerAlreadyStarted `constants`

##### Summary

This error return is deprecated as of CUDA 5.0. It is no longer an error
to call cuProfilerStart() when profiling is already enabled.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorProfilerAlreadyStopped'></a>
### ErrorProfilerAlreadyStopped `constants`

##### Summary

This error return is deprecated as of CUDA 5.0. It is no longer an error
to call cuProfilerStop() when profiling is already disabled.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorProfilerDisabled'></a>
### ErrorProfilerDisabled `constants`

##### Summary

This indicates profiler is not initialized for this run.
This can happen when the application is running with external profiling tools
like visual profiler.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorProfilerNotInitialized'></a>
### ErrorProfilerNotInitialized `constants`

##### Summary

This error return is deprecated as of CUDA 5.0. It is no longer an error
to attempt to enable/disable the profiling via ::cuProfilerStart or
::cuProfilerStop without initialization.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorSetOnActiveProcess'></a>
### ErrorSetOnActiveProcess `constants`

##### Summary

This indicates that the user has called ::cudaSetValidDevices(),
::cudaSetDeviceFlags(), ::cudaD3D9SetDirect3DDevice(),
::cudaD3D10SetDirect3DDevice, ::cudaD3D11SetDirect3DDevice(), or
::cudaVDPAUSetVDPAUDevice() after initializing the CUDA runtime by
calling non-device management operations (allocating memory and
launching kernels are examples of non-device management operations).
This error can also be returned if using runtime/driver
interoperability and there is an existing ::CUcontext active on the
host thread.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorSharedObjectInitFailed'></a>
### ErrorSharedObjectInitFailed `constants`

##### Summary

This indicates that initialization of a shared object failed.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorSharedObjectSymbolNotFound'></a>
### ErrorSharedObjectSymbolNotFound `constants`

##### Summary

This indicates that a link to a shared object failed to resolve.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorStartupFailure'></a>
### ErrorStartupFailure `constants`

##### Summary

This indicates an internal startup failure in the CUDA runtime.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorStreamCaptureImplicit'></a>
### ErrorStreamCaptureImplicit `constants`

##### Summary

The operation would have resulted in a disallowed implicit dependency on
a current capture sequence from cudaStreamLegacy.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorStreamCaptureInvalidated'></a>
### ErrorStreamCaptureInvalidated `constants`

##### Summary

The current capture sequence on the stream has been invalidated due to
a previous error.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorStreamCaptureIsolation'></a>
### ErrorStreamCaptureIsolation `constants`

##### Summary

A dependency would have been created which crosses the capture sequence
boundary. Only implicit in-stream ordering dependencies are allowed to
cross the boundary.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorStreamCaptureMerge'></a>
### ErrorStreamCaptureMerge `constants`

##### Summary

The operation would have resulted in a merge of two independent capture
sequences.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorStreamCaptureUnjoined'></a>
### ErrorStreamCaptureUnjoined `constants`

##### Summary

The capture sequence contains a fork that was not joined to the primary
stream.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorStreamCaptureUnmatched'></a>
### ErrorStreamCaptureUnmatched `constants`

##### Summary

The capture was not initiated in this stream.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorStreamCaptureUnsupported'></a>
### ErrorStreamCaptureUnsupported `constants`

##### Summary

The operation is not permitted when the stream is capturing.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorStreamCaptureWrongThread'></a>
### ErrorStreamCaptureWrongThread `constants`

##### Summary

A stream capture sequence not initiated with the ::cudaStreamCaptureModeRelaxed
argument to ::cudaStreamBeginCapture was passed to ::cudaStreamEndCapture in a
different thread.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorSymbolNotFound'></a>
### ErrorSymbolNotFound `constants`

##### Summary

This indicates that a named symbol was not found. Examples of symbols
are global/constant variable names, texture names, and surface names.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorSyncDepthExceeded'></a>
### ErrorSyncDepthExceeded `constants`

##### Summary

This error indicates that a call to [cudaDeviceSynchronize](#M-CudaCSharp-Runtime-Cuda-NativeMethods-cudaDeviceSynchronize 'CudaCSharp.Runtime.Cuda.NativeMethods.cudaDeviceSynchronize') made from
the device runtime failed because the call was made at grid depth greater
than either the default (2 levels of grids) or user specified device 
limit 'cudaLimitDevRuntimeSyncDepth'. To be able to synchronize on 
launched grids at a greater depth successfully, the maximum nested 
depth at which :[cudaDeviceSynchronize](#M-CudaCSharp-Runtime-Cuda-NativeMethods-cudaDeviceSynchronize 'CudaCSharp.Runtime.Cuda.NativeMethods.cudaDeviceSynchronize') will be called must be specified 
with the 'cudaLimitDevRuntimeSyncDepth' limit to the 'cudaDeviceSetLimit'
API before the host-side launch of a kernel using the device runtime. 
Keep in mind that additional levels of sync depth require the runtime 
to reserve large amounts of device memory that cannot be used for 
user allocations.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorSynchronizationError'></a>
### ErrorSynchronizationError `constants`

##### Summary

This indicated that a synchronization operation had failed.
This was previously used for some device emulation functions.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorSystemDriverMismatch'></a>
### ErrorSystemDriverMismatch `constants`

##### Summary

This error indicates that there is a mismatch between the versions of
the display driver and the CUDA driver. Refer to the compatibility documentation
for supported versions.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorSystemNotReady'></a>
### ErrorSystemNotReady `constants`

##### Summary

This error indicates that the system is not yet ready to start any CUDA
work.  To continue using CUDA, verify the system configuration is in a
valid state and all required driver daemons are actively running.
More information about this error can be found in the system specific
user guide.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorTextureFetchFailed'></a>
### ErrorTextureFetchFailed `constants`

##### Summary

This indicated that a texture fetch was not able to be performed.
This was previously used for device emulation of texture operations.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorTextureNotBound'></a>
### ErrorTextureNotBound `constants`

##### Summary

This indicated that a texture was not bound for access.
This was previously used for device emulation of texture operations.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorTimeout'></a>
### ErrorTimeout `constants`

##### Summary

This indicates that the wait operation has timed out.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorTooManyPeers'></a>
### ErrorTooManyPeers `constants`

##### Summary

This error indicates that the hardware resources required to enable
peer access have been exhausted for one or more of the devices 
passed to ::EnablePeerAccess().

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorUnknown'></a>
### ErrorUnknown `constants`

##### Summary

This indicates that an unknown internal error has occurred.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorUnmapBufferObjectFailed'></a>
### ErrorUnmapBufferObjectFailed `constants`

##### Summary

This indicates that the buffer object could not be unmapped.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-ErrorUnsupportedLimit'></a>
### ErrorUnsupportedLimit `constants`

##### Summary

This indicates that the ::cudaLimit passed to the API call is not
supported by the active device.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-CudaError-Success'></a>
### Success `constants`

##### Summary

No errors

<a name='T-CudaCSharp-Rng-Cuda-CudaRand'></a>
## CudaRand `type`

##### Namespace

CudaCSharp.Rng.Cuda

<a name='M-CudaCSharp-Rng-Cuda-CudaRand-Finalize'></a>
### Finalize() `method`

##### Summary

The finalize method invoked by the GC

##### Parameters

This method has no parameters.

<a name='M-CudaCSharp-Rng-Cuda-CudaRand-SetDimensions-System-UInt32-'></a>
### SetDimensions(dimensions) `method`

##### Summary

Set the number of dimensions to be generated by the quasi-random number generator. Legal values for `dimensions` are 1 to 20000.

##### Parameters

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| dimensions | [System.UInt32](http://msdn.microsoft.com/query/dev14.query?appId=Dev14IDEF1&l=EN-US&k=k:System.UInt32 'System.UInt32') | number of dimensions |

##### Exceptions

| Name | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| [CudaCSharp.StatusException](#T-CudaCSharp-StatusException 'CudaCSharp.StatusException') | if the returned status is not success |

<a name='M-CudaCSharp-Rng-Cuda-CudaRand-SetOffset-System-UInt64-'></a>
### SetOffset(offset) `method`

##### Summary

Set the absolute offset of the pseudo or quasi-random number generator. All values of offset are valid.
The offset position is absolute, not relative to the current position in the sequence.

##### Parameters

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| offset | [System.UInt64](http://msdn.microsoft.com/query/dev14.query?appId=Dev14IDEF1&l=EN-US&k=k:System.UInt64 'System.UInt64') | the [UInt64](http://msdn.microsoft.com/query/dev14.query?appId=Dev14IDEF1&l=EN-US&k=k:System.UInt64 'System.UInt64') offset to set |

##### Exceptions

| Name | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| [CudaCSharp.StatusException](#T-CudaCSharp-StatusException 'CudaCSharp.StatusException') | if the returned status is not success |

<a name='M-CudaCSharp-Rng-Cuda-CudaRand-SetOrder-CudaCSharp-Rng-Cuda-Ordering-'></a>
### SetOrder(order) `method`

##### Summary

Set the ordering of results of the pseudo or quasi-random number generator.

##### Parameters

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| order | [CudaCSharp.Rng.Cuda.Ordering](#T-CudaCSharp-Rng-Cuda-Ordering 'CudaCSharp.Rng.Cuda.Ordering') | Legal values of order for pseudo-random generators are:
Legal values of order for quasi-random generators is [QuasiDefault](#F-CudaCSharp-Rng-Cuda-Ordering-QuasiDefault 'CudaCSharp.Rng.Cuda.Ordering.QuasiDefault') |

<a name='T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrixToSparseAlgorithm'></a>
## DenseMatrixToSparseAlgorithm `type`

##### Namespace

CudaCSharp.Arrays

##### Summary

The algorithm used to prune a dense matrix, the priorities of default algorithms are the corresponding [Int32](http://msdn.microsoft.com/query/dev14.query?appId=Dev14IDEF1&l=EN-US&k=k:System.Int32 'System.Int32') representations.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrixToSparseAlgorithm-NonzeroThresholdDefault'></a>
### NonzeroThresholdDefault `constants`

##### Summary

Default algorithm when the threshold is larger than 0, which takes a two-step approach:

This is more time efficient than [ZeroThresholdDefault](#F-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrixToSparseAlgorithm-ZeroThresholdDefault 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrixToSparseAlgorithm.ZeroThresholdDefault') but less memory efficient than it when the threshold is not zero.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrixToSparseAlgorithm-RealDefault'></a>
### RealDefault `constants`

##### Summary

Default algorithm when data type is a real type, which utilizes the CUDA Sparse API only for real-typed [CSR](#F-CudaCSharp-SparseMatrixFormat-CSR 'CudaCSharp.SparseMatrixFormat.CSR') matrix. Although other formats are supported by applying the transposed dense matrix first (for [CSC](#F-CudaCSharp-SparseMatrixFormat-CSC 'CudaCSharp.SparseMatrixFormat.CSC')) or convert at last (for [Coordinated](#F-CudaCSharp-SparseMatrixFormat-Coordinated 'CudaCSharp.SparseMatrixFormat.Coordinated')), it may slows the process.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrixToSparseAlgorithm-ViaVector'></a>
### ViaVector `constants`

##### Summary

Algorithm that takes a three-step approach and utilizes the [ToSparse](#M-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseVector`1-ToSparse-System-Single- 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseVector`1.ToSparse(System.Single)') and [ToMatrix](#M-CudaCSharp-Arrays-SparseVector`1-ToMatrix-System-Int64- 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.SparseVector`1.ToMatrix(System.Int64)') method:

The extra memory consumption of this algorithm is three times the size of the [DenseMatrix\`1](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix`1 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix`1'). The performance in time is not tested yet. This may be more efficient when the shape of [DenseMatrix\`1](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix`1 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix`1') is far from square.

<a name='F-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrixToSparseAlgorithm-ZeroThresholdDefault'></a>
### ZeroThresholdDefault `constants`

##### Summary

Default algorithm when the threshold is 0, which takes a two-step approach:

This is more efficient when the second step is not executed, even when the target format is [Coordinated](#F-CudaCSharp-SparseMatrixFormat-Coordinated 'CudaCSharp.SparseMatrixFormat.Coordinated') since the conversion from [Compressed](#F-CudaCSharp-SparseMatrixFormat-Compressed 'CudaCSharp.SparseMatrixFormat.Compressed') to [Coordinated](#F-CudaCSharp-SparseMatrixFormat-Coordinated 'CudaCSharp.SparseMatrixFormat.Coordinated') is both time and memory efficient.

## DenseMatrix\`1 `type`

##### Namespace

CudaCSharp.Arrays

##### Summary

The dense matrix class that inherit the [MatrixBase\`1](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-MatrixBase`1 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.MatrixBase`1') and implements the [IPrintable](#T-CudaCSharp-IPrintable 'CudaCSharp.IPrintable').

##### Generic Types

| Name | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| T | the supported data types are [Single](http://msdn.microsoft.com/query/dev14.query?appId=Dev14IDEF1&l=EN-US&k=k:System.Single 'System.Single'), [Double](http://msdn.microsoft.com/query/dev14.query?appId=Dev14IDEF1&l=EN-US&k=k:System.Double 'System.Double'), [FloatComplex](#T-CudaCSharp-FloatComplex 'CudaCSharp.FloatComplex'), [DoubleComplex](#T-CudaCSharp-DoubleComplex 'CudaCSharp.DoubleComplex'); other types of data causes [NotSupportedException](http://msdn.microsoft.com/query/dev14.query?appId=Dev14IDEF1&l=EN-US&k=k:System.NotSupportedException 'System.NotSupportedException') |

##### Remarks

Matrices are stored in the column-major format in the memory. This is often known as the `Fortran` or the `MATLAB` way.

<a name='M-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix`1-EigensystemHerm-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseVector{`0},CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix{`0},CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix{`0},CudaCSharp-Solver-EigType-'></a>
### EigensystemHerm(overwriteValues,overwriteVectors,B,type) `method`

##### Summary

Calculate the eigenvalues (and eigenvectors) of this Hermitian matrix for the special eigen-problem -- $A V = V \Lambda$, or matrices pair A, `B` for the general one -- $A V = \Lambda B V$ or $A B V = \Lambda V$ or $B A V = \Lambda V$ . Here, matrix A is this matrix.

##### Returns

The eigenvalues and the eigenvectors.

##### Parameters

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| overwriteValues | [CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseVector{\`0}](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseVector{`0} 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseVector{`0}') | the [DenseVector\`1](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseVector`1 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseVector`1') to store eigenvalues, default null means that this method will create a new one and return |
| overwriteVectors | [CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix{\`0}](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix{`0} 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix{`0}') | the [DenseMatrix\`1](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix`1 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix`1') to store eigenvectors, default null means that this method will create a new one and return |
| B | [CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix{\`0}](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix{`0} 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix{`0}') | the input [DenseMatrix\`1](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix`1 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix`1') to calculate general eigen-problem; if ` is null`, the normal eigen is performed and `type` is not used; otherwise, the general one is performed |
| type | [CudaCSharp.Solver.EigType](#T-CudaCSharp-Solver-EigType 'CudaCSharp.Solver.EigType') | the [EigType](#T-CudaCSharp-Solver-EigType 'CudaCSharp.Solver.EigType') to indicate positions of this matrix and `B` |

##### Exceptions

| Name | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| [System.NotSupportedException](http://msdn.microsoft.com/query/dev14.query?appId=Dev14IDEF1&l=EN-US&k=k:System.NotSupportedException 'System.NotSupportedException') | if `T` is not one of the supported type |
| [CudaCSharp.StatusException](#T-CudaCSharp-StatusException 'CudaCSharp.StatusException') | if the internal calculation returns error status |
| [CudaCSharp.Solver.MatrixAlgorithmException](#T-CudaCSharp-Solver-MatrixAlgorithmException 'CudaCSharp.Solver.MatrixAlgorithmException') | if the internal calculation fails |

<a name='M-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix`1-Eigensystem``1-System-Boolean,CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseVector{``0},CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix{`0},CudaCSharp-Solver-EigType-'></a>
### Eigensystem\`\`1(calcLeft,overwriteValues,B,type) `method`

##### Summary

Calculate the eigenvalues (and eigenvectors) of given matrix A for the special eigen-problem -- $A V = V \Lambda$, or matrices pair A, `B` for the general one -- $A V = \Lambda B V$ or $A B V = \Lambda V$ or $B A V = \Lambda V$. Here, matrix A is this matrix.

##### Returns

The eigenvalues and the eigenvectors. If both this matrix and `B` are Hermitian, this matrix will be overwritten by eigenvectors and the output `left` and `right` are both null. Otherwise, the output `left` and `right` store the output left and right eigenvectors

##### Parameters

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| calcLeft | [System.Boolean](http://msdn.microsoft.com/query/dev14.query?appId=Dev14IDEF1&l=EN-US&k=k:System.Boolean 'System.Boolean') | calculate both left and right eigenvectors or only right eigenvectors |
| overwriteValues | [CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseVector{\`\`0}](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseVector{``0} 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseVector{``0}') | the [DenseVector\`1](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseVector`1 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseVector`1') to store eigenvalues, default null means that this method will create a new one and return |
| B | [CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix{\`0}](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseMatrix{`0} 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseMatrix{`0}') | the input [MatrixBase\`1](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-MatrixBase`1 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.MatrixBase`1') to calculate general eigen-problem; if ` is null`, the normal eigen is performed and `type` is not used; otherwise, the general one is performed |
| type | [CudaCSharp.Solver.EigType](#T-CudaCSharp-Solver-EigType 'CudaCSharp.Solver.EigType') | the [EigType](#T-CudaCSharp-Solver-EigType 'CudaCSharp.Solver.EigType') to indicate positions of this matrix and `B` |

##### Generic Types

| Name | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| TOut | The output eigenvalues' data type corresponding to `T`: |

##### Exceptions

| Name | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| [System.NotSupportedException](http://msdn.microsoft.com/query/dev14.query?appId=Dev14IDEF1&l=EN-US&k=k:System.NotSupportedException 'System.NotSupportedException') | if `T` is not one of the supported type or `T` and `TOut` do not match |
| [CudaCSharp.StatusException](#T-CudaCSharp-StatusException 'CudaCSharp.StatusException') | if the internal calculation returns error status |
| [CudaCSharp.Solver.MatrixAlgorithmException](#T-CudaCSharp-Solver-MatrixAlgorithmException 'CudaCSharp.Solver.MatrixAlgorithmException') | if the internal calculation fails |

##### Summary

Compute Hermitian rank-k update $C_{\text{this}} = \alpha A^{\text{op}} A^{\text{op}}^H + \beta C_{\text{this}}$.

##### Parameters

| op | [\`0](#T-`0 '`0') | operation to matrix `A` |
| α | [\`0](#T-`0 '`0') | scalar of type `T` |
| β | [CudaCSharp.MatrixOperation](#T-CudaCSharp-MatrixOperation 'CudaCSharp.MatrixOperation') | scalar of type `T` |

<a name='M-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseTensor`1-Contract-`0,CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseTensor{`0},CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseTensor{`0},`0,CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseTensor{`0}-'></a>
### Contract(α,A,B,β,C) `method`

##### Summary

Contract two tensors `A` and `B`: $\text{this}_{i_0,i_1,...,i_n} = \alpha \sum_{j_a = k_b}{A_{j_0,j_1,...,j_p} \cdot B_{k_0,k_1,...,k_q}} + \beta C_{i_0,i_1,...,i_n}$;

##### Parameters

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| α | [\`0](#T-`0 '`0') | scalar α |
| A | [CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseTensor{\`0}](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseTensor{`0} 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseTensor{`0}') | [DenseTensor\`1](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseTensor`1 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseTensor`1') A |
| B | [CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseTensor{\`0}](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseTensor{`0} 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseTensor{`0}') | [DenseTensor\`1](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseTensor`1 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseTensor`1') B |
| β | [\`0](#T-`0 '`0') | scalar β, default 0 |
| C | [CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseTensor{\`0}](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseTensor{`0} 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseTensor{`0}') | [DenseTensor\`1](#T-CudaCSharp-Arrays-DenseTensor`1 'CudaCSharp.Arrays.DenseTensor`1') C, default null means this |

##### Remarks

If `C` is null, or `β` is zero, this tensor itself will be used instead of `C`.
